title: Modify: Space the Card
prompt:
The `.card` is cramped. Without changing its width or border:

- Give the card `padding: 1.5rem` (breathing room *inside*).
- Give it `margin: 0 auto 1.5rem` — centered horizontally (the `auto` does it), with bottom margin for the next section.
- Give it a `border-radius` of `8px`.
boilerplate:
Club membership

Everything a member needs, one flat rate.

tests.name: padding added
tests.hint: padding sits between content and border — inside the box.

tests.name: centered with bottom margin
tests.hint: auto horizontal margins + a definite width = centered block.

tests.name: rounded corners
width and border untouched
tests.hint: Modification challenges change only what the brief asks for.
